summary: An easy, friendly daily: every answer is a country people know, and the only debate is that China and Thailand are not in it. Good for a gentle day.
reasons: Casual finds all 10 in 12 guesses, losing lives only on China and Thailand. On the easy side, but Turkey at #4 and Greece at #10 give a little surprise.
Every other country is unranked, so China and Thailand cost a life with no '#11' to learn from, and the list is not Blitz-ready.
fixes: Only the top 10 carry a value. Add ranks 11+ from the page's regional tables (Thailand, China, Austria, UAE, etc.) so near misses show a rank and the list can be Blitz-ready.
